comparison.objective: Push a cooker until its rear foot enters an anti-tip bracket, versus tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object pushing and hidden foot/bracket alignment versus small-tool engagement, fine rotation, counterholding, and controlled torque.
comparison.success_condition: Rear foot captured by bracket versus two safe repeatable stops within energy, velocity, travel, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both involve physical constraints, but they test materially different manipulation and outcomes. Body and specs are absent.
